answer.rationale: The scenario describes a work-related amputation requiring in-patient hospitalization, which is unambiguously recordable under §1904.7(a) and §1904.4(a). It triggers the 24-hour severe injury reporting requirement under §1904.39(a)(2) since it involves an amputation and in-patient hospitalization. The employer must also log the case within 7 days per §1904.29(b)(3) and retain records for 5 years per §1904.33(a). No process safety, hazcom, or LOTO facts are present in the scenario, so those requirement sets are not applicable given the facts supplied.
